anomalies.description: A man is seen grabbing and restraining a woman from behind near a window; her body is contorted and she appears distressed, indicating non-consensual physical control.

The man overpowers and physically controls a woman who appears unable to resist, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim; the sequence shows him grabbing her, pulling her down, and moving aggressively while she is blurred and passive.

A man in a black jacket is engaged in a physical struggle with a woman; he grabs her from behind and appears to be restraining or attacking her, as seen in the motion-blurred frames showing close contact and forceful movement.

The man forcefully covers the woman’s mouth and nose with his hand while holding her tightly; her eyes are wide and face shows clear distress, consistent with suffocation or silencing of a helpless victim.
The man is seen holding the woman tightly against his chest with both arms, her face pressed into his shoulder, eyes closed and expression distressed—consistent with coercive restraint or smothering.
